mapper.select: SELECT sysDictNode.id, sysDictNode.parent_id AS parentId, sysDictNode.code, sysDictNode.name, sysDictNode.sort, sysDictNode.status, sysDictNode.remark, sysDictNode.create_id AS createId, sysDictNode.create_name AS createName, sysDictNode.create_time AS createTime, sysDictNode.update_id AS updateId, sysDictNode.update_name AS updateName, sysDictNode.update_time AS updateTime, sysDictNode.deleted, sysDictNode.delete_id AS deleteId, sysDictNode.delete_name AS deleteName, sysDictNode.delete_time AS deleteTime FROM sys_dict_node sysDictNode WHERE sysDictNode.deleted = 0 ORDER BY sysDictNode.sort ASC, sysDictNode.code ASC, sysDictNode.id ASC

SELECT sysDictNode.id, sysDictNode.parent_id AS parentId, sysDictNode.code, sysDictNode.name, sysDictNode.sort, sysDictNode.status, sysDictNode.remark, sysDictNode.create_id AS createId, sysDictNode.create_name AS createName, sysDictNode.create_time AS createTime, sysDictNode.update_id AS updateId, sysDictNode.update_name AS updateName, sysDictNode.update_time AS updateTime, sysDictNode.deleted, sysDictNode.delete_id AS deleteId, sysDictNode.delete_name AS deleteName, sysDictNode.delete_time AS deleteTime FROM sys_dict_node sysDictNode WHERE sysDictNode.deleted = 0 AND sysDictNode.parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY sysDictNode.sort ASC, sysDictNode.code ASC, sysDictNode.id ASC
